query: INSERT INTO twitch_engagement_learn_channels (channel_login, channel_user_id, message_count) VALUES ($1, $2, 1) ON CONFLICT (channel_login) DO UPDATE SET last_seen_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, message_count = twitch_engagement_learn_channels.message_count + 1, channel_user_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.channel_user_id, twitch_engagement_learn_channels.channel_user_id)
